source_fixes: Resolved the initial full MyPy findings in data identity annotations, Binance sealed-window narrowing, RouteB hierarchy array handling, frame protocol mutability, R4 runner configuration typing, and QA smoke argument validation.
AccountFactsAccumulator now stores exact period returns in array('d') to avoid per-observation Python float/list-pointer overhead while preserving exact VaR/CVaR input values.
ES training environments disable report-only snapshot and fill-reference retention; same-seed observations, rewards, terminations, truncations, and info remain equal to diagnostic mode.
Native metrics reuse an already time-ordered snapshot Sequence and only allocate a sorted list for genuinely out-of-order input, preserving stable same-time barriers.
R4 now verifies preregistered SHA-256 values for protocol JSON, Fold config, and runner source before research access; changed, missing, or duplicated digest lines fail closed.
WorldModel worker forecast requests now reject noncanonical instruments and nonfinite, Boolean, or nonpositive single-anchor closes before model inference.
data_scope: synthetic unit fixtures only; no market, account, Validation, Test, or Holdout payload was read
